lessons.title: Attribute a result
lessons.learn: Attribute a result to its source and name a limit.

grammar.title: attribution with 根据

lessons.title: Distinguish a cause from a link
lessons.learn: Describe a possible relationship without claiming that it proves causation.

grammar.title: possible cause
grammar.pattern: 可能与 ... 有关，但还需要 ...
grammar.explain: 可能 marks a possibility; name the additional check needed before claiming a cause.

examples.t: 出勤率有所提高。
examples.r: chū qín lǜ yǒu suǒ tí gāo。
examples.en: Attendance has increased.

examples.t: 这可能与新的公交路线有关。
examples.r: zhè kě néng yǔ xīn de gōng jiāo lù xiàn yǒu guān。
examples.en: This may be related to the new bus route.

examples.t: 要确认原因，还需要更多数据。
examples.r: yào què rèn yuán yīn，hái xū yào gèng duō shù jù。
examples.en: More data are needed to confirm the cause.

mistakes.wrong: 公交路线肯定提高了出勤率。
mistakes.right: 公交路线可能与出勤率提高有关。
mistakes.why: A possible relationship is not proof of causation.

culture.text: Chinese speakers use different regional varieties and accents; Standard Mandarin is one shared learning target, not a claim that other varieties are incorrect. In conversation, a speaker may rephrase a word or write it down when listeners use different regional vocabulary. At B1+, a learner connects evidence, explanation and a proposed action. A report becomes more useful when it names which source supports each statement and what remains to be checked.

reading.text: 调查小组先听居民的意见，再看用水数据。两个社区的情况不完全一样。负责人建议增加一次测量，然后再讨论供水方案。 小组先比较了测量结果，再听居民说明。两个来源回答的问题不同，所以总结把数据和个人经验分开写。
reading.gloss: The survey team first listened to residents' views and then reviewed water-use data. The two communities were not in exactly the same situation. The coordinator suggested taking one more measurement before discussing the supply plan. The team first compared measurements and then listened to residents. The two sources answer different questions, so the summary kept data and personal experience separate.

listening.script:
组员：这组数据能代表两个社区吗？
负责人：现在还不能，样本比较小。
组员：那我们先把结论写成暂定意见。
负责人：好，再补一次测量。
编辑：两个来源说的是同一件事吗？
研究者：不完全一样，一个是测量，一个是经验。
编辑：那就分别说明它们的范围。
listening.gloss: Team member: Can these data represent both communities? Coordinator: Not yet; the sample is rather small. Team member: Then let's label the finding provisional. Coordinator: Good, and add another measurement. Editor: Are the two sources saying the same thing? Researcher: Not exactly; one is a measurement and the other is experience. Editor: Then we will state their scopes separately.
